dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Distinct pale-grey margins on primary and secondary feathers providing sharp contrast against the dark feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse transition where fine longitudinal streaking on the nape meets the broad scalloped patterning of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive scalloped dorsal pattern resulting from wide, light-colored fringes on individual mantle and covert feathers.
